source: Assistant-authored evaluation descriptions; no model or motion generator has been invoked for this suite.
unit_of_primary_summary: semantic_group; keep two paraphrases and all random seeds nested within each group
training_policy: Exclude every new suite group configuration and its synonymous paraphrases/translations from new training and validation. Overlapping atomic action families are allowed; report held-out configuration/composition generalization, not unseen action-family generalization. Preserve the old 2000 rows and four seen-diagnostic descriptions unchanged. Exact signatures are an aid, not a substitute for manual semantic review of aliases.

diagnostic_policy.meaning: The four old diagnostic descriptions have already informed the repair. Improvements on them or the same capability are known-issue regressions, not evidence of unseen generalization. Do not exclude the entire overhead/explanation action families.

metric_vocabulary.wrist_relative_height_m: Per-side wrist world Y minus named reference joint world Y; keep bilateral observations per side and jointly simultaneous. Shoulder reach band +/-0.12 m and head+0.05 m are necessary proxy observations, not final pose success.
metric_vocabulary.wrist_excursion_m: Report displacement/activity, with no frozen pass threshold for low_activity.
metric_vocabulary.inter_wrist_distance_m: Report the time series and extrema; distance alone does not prove contact or palms facing each other.
metric_vocabulary.head_rotation_excursion_deg: Head relative to upper chest, explicit pitch/yaw/roll; do not guess axis from text.
metric_vocabulary.upper_torso_rotation_excursion_deg: Upper chest relative to hips; explicit pitch/yaw/roll.
metric_vocabulary.shoulder_height_change_m: Shoulder vertical change relative to hips; retain each side.
metric_vocabulary.repetition_count: Requested cycle/event count; an unimplemented event detector is manual/unknown.
metric_vocabulary.event_order: Explicit ordered event labels; an unimplemented event detector is manual/unknown.
